name: multimesh_v8t
notes: v8t, the no-mesh probe of v8: four stations, four MIGs, four system nodes (ktpu_node_v8t: sysnode with the fabric side tied off, 64 URAM staging, RV32 complex) on ONE sysnode clock (mesh 1's wizard output 3 = 'sys'; wizards 0/2/3 keep only an unloaded first output), ONE partition-aware Kohaku Xache (kx_pxache P=4, a partition per die, 64 URAM per MIG, HCDC on the four DRAM edges only, 16 KB rotation over a flat 16 GB at [33:0], mesh bits [37:36] zero). NO mesh, NO interlink: a kick has nowhere to go; the image exists to measure the memory path. Addressing as v8: (m+1)<<40 picks WHICH node the host enters through, never a channel; every DRAM address must be below 16 GB with [37:36] = 0. Retuning 'sys' on mesh 1 retunes every node and the Xache together. NOT PROGRAMMED by the flow that built it; no on-silicon acceptance yet.
